quote: But we have only begun / to love the earth. / We have only begun / to imagine the fulness of life. / How could we tire of hope? / —so much is in bud.
source: Denise Levertov, Beginners, the lines after the Swinburne epigraph, Candles in Babylon (New Directions, 1982)
note: Corrected wording to the 1982 New Directions text, which spells fulness with one l, and to its lower case line heads: Levertov’s own lines begin to love and to imagine after the capitalised Swinburne quotation. Wording checked in the scan of Candles in Babylon; the lower case in two critical studies that quote the book.
